# Bundled Lottie runtime

`lottie.min.js` is the browser-rendered lottie-web/Bodymovin runtime 5.12.2, downloaded from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bodymovin/5.12.2/lottie.min.js .

Project: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web  
License: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web/blob/master/LICENSE.md (MIT).

Standalone approved Lottie JSON animations live in `../lottie/`. Missing art is not fabricated.
